title: Grateful Dead Live at Moscone Convention Center on 1982-05-28

ai_review.summary: Muffled audience‑recorded tape of a chaotic benefit gig where the Dead were barely audible but Boz Scaggs/John Cipollina’s second‑set blew up.
ai_review.review: The recording captures an uneven night: the Dead’s first set suffers from muffled sound and half‑hearted, intoxicated playing (Jerry’s vocals are often gone), while the surprise guest jam with Boz Scaggs and John Cipollina in the second set provides the highlight. Technically the tape is only fair due to poor venue acoustics, but the odd moments give it some collectible charm.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is mediocre (Dead’s performance weak) offset by a strong guest second set; recording is only fair because of muffled, arena‑recorded sound.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Venue acoustics with big pillars made the mix muddy and vocals (especially Jerry's) often inaudible; overall tape is listenable but lacking clarity.

standout_songs: Boz Scaggs & John Cipollina jam (blues/rock set)
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set hampered by poor sound and sloppy playing; second set revives the night with guest blues/rock jams that outshine the Dead's material.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Vocals often shut off, sounded wasted and could barely stand or play.
band_member_comments.Bob: Weir described as high on drugs during his set.
